# Project Structure

## Project type

Python backend/controller with a command-line client and REST API. No source-backed browser frontend or dashboard exists. FastAPI exposes its generated Swagger UI at the framework default `/docs` and ReDoc at `/redoc`; these are documentation interfaces, not a custom dashboard.

## Top-level modules and layers

| Area | Python files | Responsibility evidenced in source |
|---|---:|---|
| `controller/` | 10 | FastAPI application, controller daemon, app/container lifecycle manager, scaling, Nginx configuration, health checks, and cluster/leader coordination |
| `state/` | 2 | PostgreSQL persistence, state records, and state-store operations |
| `metrics/` | 2 | Metrics export |
| `cli/` | 3 | Typer command-line interface and API/helper logic |
| `app_spec/` | 2 | Application specification models |
| Project root | 1 | `view_db.py` database utility |

The five package directories contain 19 Python files total; the one root-level Python file is counted separately. Counts were obtained by enumerating `*.py` in those directories and at the root; generated/vendor `.venv` content was excluded.

## API and runtime entrypoints

- `controller/api.py:48` constructs the FastAPI application.
- `controller/api.py:96-628` declares 19 HTTP operations under `/apps`, `/metrics`, `/events`, `/cluster`, `/lb-health`, and `/health`.
- `controller/api.py:67,72` registers startup and shutdown lifecycle hooks.
- FastAPI's source-level defaults imply `/docs`, `/redoc`, and `/openapi.json`; the server was not reachable at the local probe URL, so their live availability/content was not verified.
- `controller/main.py:45-111` defines the controller daemon entrypoint, reads host/port settings, imports the FastAPI app, and invokes Uvicorn.
- `cli/main.py` defines the Typer CLI (`orchestry = cli.main:app` in `pyproject.toml`). CLI commands were not enumerated as dashboard units.

## Layer relationships

`controller/api.py` is the HTTP boundary. It delegates application operations to `controller/manager.py`, scaling to `controller/scaler.py`, state/event persistence to `state/db.py` through `controller/utils/lifecycle.py`, and monitoring/cluster operations to the health, metrics, Nginx, and cluster modules. `controller/utils/models.py` defines request/response data models. `configs/` holds container, PostgreSQL, and Nginx runtime configuration; `docs/` holds project documentation.

## Functional areas

- Application registration, lifecycle, status, raw specification, scaling, and policy management.
- Per-application logs and metrics plus system metrics and event history.
- Controller cluster membership, leader information, and health.
- Container management, health checking, and Nginx load balancing.
- CLI-based client operations and PostgreSQL-backed persistent state.

## Dashboard planning boundary

The dashboard must be planned as a new browser client of the existing API. No existing UI components, routes, frontend assets, frontend package manifest, or client framework were found in the source inventory. The existing `/docs` Swagger UI is generated by FastAPI and is a separate documentation surface.
